Neutrino-1 8B

Overview

Neutrino-1 8B is an 8.19B-parameter decoder-only transformer that ships as one 3.88 GB file. Every one of its 252 transformer linears is stored in a proprietary ternary-family weight format eight times smaller than fp16; the weights stay bit-packed at rest and are decoded inside the matrix kernels, so nothing in the decode path is stored as fp16 or fp32 weight material.

Small weights change the serving economics. Single-stream decode is bound by how many bytes move per token, so a 3.88 GB working set decodes at rates a 16 GB fp16 artifact cannot reach on the same memory system, and the whole model fits beside its KV cache on an 8 GB GPU or a 16 GB laptop. The same container serves every platform below without conversion.

Architecture

A dense decoder-only transformer. Grouped-query attention holds the KV cache at a quarter of the query width, 288 KiB per token at the live fp32 default, so a 4k-token session costs 1.21 GB of cache beside the 3.88 GB of weights.

Where the bytes live

Only the transformer linears carry the coded format. The two embedding tensors stay int8 because their rows are read one token at a time, not multiplied against the full activation stream, and the normalization weights are too small to be worth coding. A third of the file is vocabulary.

Inside the coded lane

Across the 6.95B coded weights, 62.63% sit at zero and the remainder splits 18.68% plus to 18.69% minus: sign-balanced to a hundredth of a point with no constraint asking for it. The balance is not uniform in depth. The gate and down feed-forward projections spike to 70 to 72% zeros in layers 1 through 3 while all four attention projections hold within about one point of 62% at every depth: the early feed-forward blocks shed weights the network does not need, and attention keeps a constant code density from layer 0 to layer 35.

Format

One container, three doors. The download is a coded transport of the container, not a compressed copy of an fp16 model: it expands bit-exactly to the file every runtime executes, and that one file is what runs on a datacenter GPU and on a laptop alike.

Distribution surfaces

pip engine

24.9 tok/s on an Apple M5, CPU only, 9 threads

The one-command door: pip install fermion-research downloads the container and the platform-matching native binary. CPU runtimes for macOS arm64 and Linux x86-64, with a bit-exact torch reference path underneath.

GGUF pack + CUDA fork

30.7 tok/s on an NVIDIA L4, 4.68 GiB at 4k context

The llama.cpp door: the container converted to GGUF with our weight types, loaded by our public llama.cpp fork. Runs llama-completion and llama-bench, with full CUDA offload.

MLX pack

33.7 tok/s on a base M5 MacBook

The Apple-silicon door: Python-native runtime with custom Metal kernels. The container is memory-mapped and the packed planes are decoded inside the GEMV kernels.

Evaluation

The release battery runs on the shipped container with thinking disabled, so every grade below is the artifact you download and not a research checkpoint. Protocol rides every row: shot count, grading mode, and item count.

Throughput

Single-stream decode, the rate that governs one prompt and one reply. Same artifact on every row; the surface changes, the weights do not.

Speculative decoding

Neutrino-1 0.6B drafts a run of tokens, the 8B scores the whole run in one forward pass, and the agreeing prefix is kept. A draft token is accepted only when it equals the 8B's own argmax, so the output stream is the plain greedy stream: on the shipping configuration, 27,648 consecutive tokens matched with zero divergences.

The speedup is draft-acceptance physics, so it is stated per prompt class over the 396 tok/s plain rate. On counting prompts the 8B accepts the full six-token draft on every pass, about seven tokens emitted per 8B forward; on factual prompts acceptance holds at 96.5%. A dynamic controller sizes each draft to the class it is decoding, which is why every class clears the plain rate.

What the pairing costs

Both containers are the same format and run on the same binaries, so the draft loads into the verifier's own process with no second deployment and no conversion step. Its 328 MB sit beside the 8B's 3.88 GB, and 4k tokens of shared context cost exactly one gibibyte of cache across the pair.

Drafting on a laptop

The pairing is not a datacenter feature. On a 16 GB Apple M5 both models load into one MLX process under a 6 GiB cap and peak at 4.3 GiB together, with the draft accounting for 0.53 GiB of it. The exactness gate returns 6 of 6 prompts token-identical with drafting on and off, and on factual prompts the drafted rate is 25.71 tok/s against 22.00 plain at an acceptance of 0.744.

Run it

Two commands to a streaming chat.

$ pip install fermion-research
$ fermion chat --model fermionresearch/Neutrino-8B

On the first 8B run, fermion 0.1.9 downloads a 2.56 GB coded transport with a progress bar, verifies its SHA-256, and unpacks it locally. Later runs load from cache.

  • A local OpenAI-compatible server
    $ fermion serve --model fermionresearch/Neutrino-8B

    Serves at http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1. Point any OpenAI client at that base URL; the key can be any string. Tool calling, streaming, and a persistent KV session are on by default.

  • Plain Transformers
    $ hf download fermionresearch/Neutrino-8B --local-dir Neutrino-8B \
        --exclude "gguf/*" --exclude "*.tv4z"
    import fermion
    from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("Neutrino-8B")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("Neutrino-8B")

    Import fermion first to register the trtc_v4 model type. Load from the downloaded local directory; passing the Hub repository id directly to from_pretrained does not work.

  • GGUF, through our llama.cpp fork only
    $ git clone https://github.com/fermionresearch/llama.cpp && cd llama.cpp
    $ git checkout fermion-fv5
    $ cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DLLAMA_CURL=OFF -DGGML_METAL=OFF
    $ cmake --build build -j --target llama-completion

    The pack uses the FV5 tensor type: stock llama.cpp, Ollama, and LM Studio cannot load it. The fermion-fv5 branch is the CPU/CUDA build and requires -DGGML_METAL=OFF. For Apple-GPU kernels, use the live fermion-fv5-metal branch and omit that flag.

  • MLX, on Apple silicon
    $ cd Neutrino-8B/mlx
    $ pip install -r requirements.txt
    $ python -m fermion_mlx --model ../neutrino-8b_v4.bin --mode chat --tokenizer .

    Run this exact sequence after downloading the repository. The working directory and relative model path are required.

The full CLI

fermion chat      an interactive streaming chat (session cache on by default)
fermion serve     a local OpenAI-compatible API with tool calling and streaming
fermion generate  one-shot completion, deterministic by default for scripts
fermion info      verify a download: container header + SHA-256 against the manifest
fermion bench     measure decode speed on your machine
fermion inspect   look inside a container: weight occupancy, per-layer bytes
fermion verify    certify a draft/target pair produces identical tokens

Every command takes --model with a Hub id or local path.

blocks.html_en: The speedup is draft-acceptance physics, so it is stated per prompt class over the 396 tok/s plain rate. Neutrino-1 8B

概述

Neutrino-1 8B 是一款 8.19B 参数解码器专用变压器，以一个 3.88 GB 文件形式提供。 其 252 个变压器线性中的每一个都以专有的三元系列权重格式存储，比 fp16 小八倍；权重在静态时保持位打包状态，并在矩阵内核内进行解码，因此解码路径中的任何内容都不会存储为 fp16 或 fp32 权重材料。

小重量改变了发球经济学。 单流解码受到每个令牌移动的字节数的限制，因此 3.88 GB 工作集的解码速度是 16 GB fp16 工件在同一内存系统上无法达到的速度，并且整个模型适合 8 GB GPU 或 16 GB 笔记本电脑上的 KV 缓存。 相同的容器服务于下面的每个平台，无需转换。

建筑学

一个密集的解码器专用变压器。 分组查询注意力将 KV 缓存保持在查询宽度的四分之一，实时 fp32 默认情况下每个令牌为 288 KiB，因此除了 3.88 GB 的权重之外，4k 令牌会话还需要 1.21 GB 的缓存。

字节所在的位置

只有变压器线性带有编码格式。 两个嵌入张量保持 int8 状态，因为它们的行一次读取一个标记，而不是与完整激活流相乘，并且归一化权重太小，不值得编码。 文件的三分之一是词汇。

编码车道内

在 6.95B 编码权重中，62.63% 位于零，其余部分分为 18.68% 正和 18.69% 负：符号平衡到百分之一的点，没有任何约束要求。 平衡的深度并不均匀。 门和下前馈预测在第 1 层到第 3 层中飙升至 70% 至 72% 零，而所有四个注意力预测在每个深度上都保持在 62% 左右的一个点内：早期前馈块放弃了网络不需要的权重，并且注意力从第 0 层到第 35 层保持恒定的代码密度。

格式

一个集装箱，三扇门。 下载的是容器的编码传输，而不是 fp16 模型的压缩副本：它会在每次运行时执行时精确地扩展为文件，并且该文件是在数据中心 GPU 和笔记本电脑上运行的文件。

评估

释放电池在运输的容器上运行，思维被禁用，因此下面的每个等级都是您下载的工件，而不是研究检查点。 每行都有协议：射击计数、评分模式和项目计数。

吞吐量

单流解码，控制一个提示和一个回复的速率。 每行都有相同的工件；表面改变，重量不变。

推测性解码

Neutrino-1 0.6B 起草一系列令牌，8B 在一次前向传递中对整个运行进行评分，并保留一致的前缀。 仅当草稿令牌等于 8B 自己的 argmax 时，它才会被接受，因此输出流是普通的贪婪流：在运输配置上，27,648 个连续令牌与零偏差相匹配。

加速是草稿接受物理原理，因此每个提示等级都以 396 tok/s 的普通速率表示。 根据计数提示，8B 在每次传递时接受完整的 6 个代币草案，每 8B 转发大约发出 7 个代币；根据事实提示，接受率为 96.5%。 动态控制器根据其正在解码的类调整每个草稿的大小，这就是每个类都清除普通速率的原因。

配对费用是多少

两个容器具有相同的格式并在相同的二进制文件上运行，因此草案加载到验证者自己的进程中，无需第二次部署，也无需转换步骤。 它的 328 MB 与 8B 的 3.88 GB 相邻，并且共享上下文的 4k 令牌在这对内存中花费了 1 GB 的缓存。

在笔记本电脑上绘图

配对不是数据中心功能。 在 16 GB Apple M5 上，两种型号均在 6 GiB 上限下加载到一个 MLX 进程中，峰值合计为 4.3 GiB，其中草稿占 0.53 GiB。 精确性门返回 6 个提示中的 6 个，与起草打开和关闭时令牌相同，并且在事实提示上，起草速率为 25.71 tok/s，而接受率为 0.744 时为 22.00 tok/s。

Run it

流式聊天的两个命令。

$ pip install fermion-research
$ fermion chat --model fermionresearch/Neutrino-8B

在第一次 8B 运行中，fermion 0.1.9 下载带有进度条的 2.56 GB 编码传输，验证其 SHA-256，并在本地解压。 稍后从缓存运行加载。

  • 本地 OpenAI 兼容服务器$ fermionserve --model fermionresearch/Neutrino-8B 在 http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1 上提供服务。将任何 OpenAI 客户端指向该基本 URL；键可以是任何字符串。 默认情况下，工具调用、流式传输和持久 KV 会话处于启用状态。
  • Plain Transformers$ hf 下载 fermionresearch/Neutrino-8B --local-dir Neutrino-8B \ --exclude "gguf/*" --exclude "*.tv4z"import fermionfrom Transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizermodel = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("Neutrino-8B")tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("Neutrino-8B")先导入fermion来注册trtc_v4模型类型。 从下载的本地目录加载；将 Hub 存储库 ID 直接传递给 from_pretrained 不起作用。
  • GGUF，仅通过我们的 llama.cpp fork $ git clone https://github.com/fermionresearch/llama.cpp && cd llama.cpp$ git checkout fermion-fv5$ cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DLLAMA_CURL=OFF -DGGML_METAL=OFF$ cmake --build build -j --target llama-completion 该包使用FV5张量类型：库存llama.cpp，Ollama和LM Studio无法加载它。 fermion-fv5 分支是 CPU/CUDA 构建，需要 -DGGML_METAL=OFF。 对于 Apple-GPU 内核，请使用 live fermion-fv5-metal 分支并忽略该标志。
  • MLX，在 Apple 芯片上$ cd Neutrino-8B/mlx$ pip install -rrequirements.txt$ python -m fermion_mlx --model ../neutrino-8b_v4.bin --mode chat --tokenizer 。下载存储库后运行此确切序列。 需要工作目录和相对模型路径。
